text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East has 7.9 days of daptomycin on hand (114 vials) and Corvale General has 18.3 days on hand (278.79 vials). Our current supply is Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. daptomycin (NDC 71288001791, SPL set ID 191f0224-67b7-4945-bdcd-38d60645e38c) manufactured at Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co.

Why (FDA record): The FDA shortage list records Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. daptomycin injection as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-06-30.

Our position: The discontinued product is not our current inventory. No public FDA signal exists for the Nanjing King-Friend plant in the provided records. Alternative manufacturers (Apotex, Accord, Aspiro) are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels name no identifiable manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 65 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp. — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Accord Healthcare Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Aspiro Pharma Limited — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
